scope.summary: Register the TAILOR_BODY_* KernelEventType additions per Section 13.16 (BK-16.4 EventLedger additions) and the 13.14 canonical event list: TailorBodyCreated, TailorBodyChannelChanged, TailorBodyRecipeSaved, TailorBodyCorrectiveBaked, TailorBodyGenitalConfigured, TailorBodySkinBaked, TailorBodyExportCompleted (minimum set), all under event_family "tailor.body", emitted on the EventLedger before their authority rows.
acceptance_criteria: KernelEventType gains variants TailorBodyCreated ("TAILOR_BODY_CREATED"), TailorBodyChannelChanged ("TAILOR_BODY_CHANNEL_CHANGED"), TailorBodyRecipeSaved ("TAILOR_BODY_RECIPE_SAVED"), TailorBodyCorrectiveBaked ("TAILOR_BODY_CORRECTIVE_BAKED"), TailorBodyGenitalConfigured ("TAILOR_BODY_GENITAL_CONFIGURED"), TailorBodySkinBaked ("TAILOR_BODY_SKIN_BAKED"), TailorBodyExportCompleted ("TAILOR_BODY_EXPORT_COMPLETED").
Every new variant maps to event_family "tailor.body" (TAILOR_BODY constant); an exhaustive-match test proves no TAILOR_BODY_* variant lacks a family mapping or serialized name.
Serialized wire names are SCREAMING_SNAKE and round-trip through serde exactly; a snapshot test makes renames impossible without a deliberate failure.

TailorBodyChannelChanged payload carries { body_id, channel_key, old_value, new_value, actor } per TAI-BK-056; all payloads carry the acted-on prefixed authority id so FlightRecorder rows are navigable by id.
The BodyKit event registry enumerates every planned later event family before downstream implementation; ad hoc event names outside the registry fail the build-readiness gate.
scope.risk_if_missed: If BodyKit mutations are not first-class ledger events, body authoring cannot be replayed or audited (TAI-OVR-007 parity breaks for bodies) and the FlightRecorder WIRED posture of every later BodyKit MT is unfulfillable.

gui_obligation.not_applicable_reason: Backend/solver scope: behavior is observable via TraceProjection, typed TAILOR_BODY_* receipts, and the 13.12 capture APIs; operator/model GUI exposure rides the BodyKit panes (13.27) and is validated there.

target_entries: Tailor UserManual > BodyKit projects and base assets

hbr_int_009_tier_obligations.reason: This MT owns authoritative, job, or external-tool lifecycle events and must project the same event_id, run_id, actor_id, and correlation_id from EventLedger into Flight Recorder.
This MT emits typed diagnostics through its owning command or job and inherits retention, health, and projection behavior from the shared diagnostics substrate.
The owning native shell or scheduled job supplies Palmistry coverage; this MT must preserve operation identity and recovery handles.

risks: Broad MT scope can hide multiple review targets.
Markdown MT lists may disagree with packet-declared active/next MT truth.
Receipt routing may target an old MT if contract identity is omitted.
minimum_controls: Exactly one primary proof target per MT unless the packet records why not.
MT identity must be stable and referenced by receipt correlation.
Generated projection drift must not wake Coder or Validator by itself.

required_changes_before_execution: Consume the signed technical refinement, canonical command/surface registries, classified HBR tiers, and task-oriented UserManual contract before execution.
